description: Contract for the mDNS service TXT record. All values are strings (mDNS encoding). Generated from hsync_common.protocol.schemas.

connected.description: Count of clients currently connected to this bucket's share (master included). Present only on a serving master; informational, never part of the election.

heartbeat.description: Monotonic liveness counter, incremented on every periodic re-announce. Opaque: receivers only rely on it changing so their staleness sweep sees fresh records for otherwise quiescent peers. Never part of the election.

peer_download.description: This node implements LAN inventory, batch source lookup and read-only seeder semantics (ADR-0028).

startup_time.description: Unix start time; earlier wins master election.

title: HSYNC LAN mDNS/TXT record (lan/1)
